metadata.description: Log Analytics workspace name that Microsoft Sentinel is enabled on
Resource name of the analytics rule 'Entra ID - Successful Legacy Auth Sign-In'

properties.displayName: Entra ID - Successful Legacy Auth Sign-In
properties.description:
Detects successful sign-ins over legacy authentication protocols
(POP, IMAP, SMTP AUTH, MAPI, Exchange ActiveSync without modern auth, etc.).
Legacy auth bypasses Conditional Access and MFA and is the #1 vector for
password spray. Successful legacy auth is almost always malicious in estates
that have fully rolled out modern auth.

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: {{UserPrincipalName}} authenticated successfully over {{ClientAppUsed}} from {{IPAddress}}. Legacy protocols bypass Conditional Access and MFA.
